structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标本身已是高度抽象的几何符号（M+圆环），符合 theme_rules 中关于保留清晰几何符号的要求。无需像游戏类 App 那样重构语义，只需将平滑的矢量线条转化为粗犷的手绘笔触，并严格执行去色和描边规则。
preserve: M 字母的基本拓扑结构（双峰波浪形态）
must_preserve: M 字母的波浪起伏形态（模拟山峰或波形）
红白配色的品牌基因映射（转为砖红/米白）
图形化的字母 M 与圆环的空间层级关系
recompose_allowed: 将平滑矢量边缘重组为抖动、粗细不均的手绘笔触
将完美正圆重组为手绘不规则椭圆
在 M 内部或周围添加主题规定的四角星装饰
restyle: 将品牌亮粉色/洋红色重绘为主题限定的高饱和度砖红/朱红
将白色部分重绘为奶黄/米白色块
应用蜡笔/马克笔的干性绘画介质质感
去除所有立体光影，改为完全平面化填充
decorate: 增加粗黑色的手绘感描边
在主体内部嵌入简单的几何装饰（如四角星）以符合 motif_rules
forbid: 禁止保留原本的亮粉色/洋红色
禁止使用平滑的矢量曲线
禁止保留原本的红色背景（必须为纯黑 #000000）
禁止添加阴影、高光、渐变或立体效果
禁止替换为相机、人脸等具象物体
generation_brief: A retro hand-drawn doodle icon of Meitu. Centered stylized letter 'M' with wavy peaks inside a rough circular ring. Colors: Brick red and creamy yellow flat fills on pure black background. Thick, uneven black marker outlines. Crayon texture, naive art style, no shadows, no gradients.
color_application: Map original brand pink/red to theme's high-saturation brick red; map white elements to creamy yellow/off-white. Strictly flat colors, no gradients.
stroke_application: Apply thick, irregular black outlines simulating hand-drawn marker strokes. Edges must be rough and jittery, not smooth vectors.
composition_application: Center the M-in-ring structure. Subject occupies 60-70% of canvas. Pure black background (#000000) with no other elements.
identity_application: Preserve the specific wavy topology of the 'M' and the enclosing circle. Ensure the shape is recognizable as Meitu's logo despite the crude stylistic transformation.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, uneven hand-drawn black outlines
Colors restricted to brick red, creamy yellow, and black
